functions.purpose: Client-side marshaller that reads the local player's six secondary-currency balances and the current shop-reset schedule, then pushes them into an ActionScript3 data object (FUN_104d1550 = AS3 setInt property) for the shop / currency panel. Values are queried from the client player object; server remains authoritative for the underlying balances.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (display marshalling; the balances and reset times originate from server-replicated player state)
formulas: Player object chain: DAT_1202e818 -> +0xd0 -> +0x90 (vtable call +0xb4) -> player context; requires context+0x2afc != 0 (shop sub-object present) before reading currencies.

Each currency read via FUN_114b7530(idx) with idx 1..6 mapped in order: 1=currencyFarmValue, 2=currencyGuildValue, 3=currencyClanMoney, 4=currencyClanMoneyPvp, 5=currencyCatMoney, 6=currencyPvpMoney (idx passed to FUN_114b7530 selects the currency slot).
shopLibType source: uVar3 = DAT_1200acdc by default, or *(param_3[0]) when param_4==0 (caller-provided shop lib type); resolved via FUN_114b7910(uVar3).

nextResetTime = FUN_11182210(shopLibType) high dword; resetBindCredit/resetCredit obtained from FUN_114b7650(&local_2c) -> FUN_11720a30 (local_28=resetCredit=local_2c, _param_4=resetBindCredit=local_28 pre-swap).
currentTime = FUN_111f8d20() (64-bit server/game time, low dword pushed).
context+0x2afc = shop/library sub-object pointer (gate for all currency reads).
costs: Currencies surfaced: currencyFarmValue, currencyGuildValue, currencyClanMoney, currencyClanMoneyPvp, currencyCatMoney, currencyPvpMoney (six secondary currencies beyond primary gold/credit).
resetBindCredit / resetCredit = credit refunded or granted at shop reset (bound vs unbound credit).
functions.notes: FUN_104d1550 is the stock AS3 int-property setter used throughout this chunk. Currency-slot->index mapping is inferred from the ordered FUN_114b7530(1..6) calls paired with the string keys; verify exact slot numbering against CCurrencyInfo.

formulas: DAT_123bf3b4 & 1 guards one-time fallback init; fallback object = &DAT_123bf3f0.
functions.notes: Stock CryEngine/MHO CInfoManager singleton pattern (identical shape to FUN_10876b30/FUN_10876bc0 for CCraftInfo).

functions.purpose: Large ActionScript3 <-> C++ bridge registration table. Repeatedly builds std::string names and binds native handler function pointers (via FUN_100b62c0 / FUN_10866f40 / cleanup FUN_10c3d5d0) for the whole tooltip / equipment / item-icon / static-data UI surface. Registers e.g. global_registerGetAttribute, global_registerGetStaticData, GetPetSkillItemInfo/Limit, MHUI_SetEquipPassiveSkillTips, MHUI_SetEquipAwakeningTips, MHUI_RegisteCommonFunction, etc.
formulas: Pure registration; no economic arithmetic. Handler targets in this chunk include FUN_1085c900 (equip tooltip), FUN_10860b90 (item fact-level), and dozens of MHUI handlers.
functions.notes: Stock UI-registration boilerplate; only the bound handler addresses matter for cross-referencing. Not authoritative.

functions.purpose: Client equipment-tooltip / item-icon data builder. Reads an item instance and emits enforce level, break level, other-equip-position, instance-channel, jewel/socket data and enforce-rule info for display. Formats strings like "%s + %d" (name+enforce), "%d*%d" (jewel grid), jewelEmpty markers.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (display; all values are server-replicated item state)
formulas: Entry gated on param_6==6 (variant tag). Reads item fields: m_nEnforceLevel, m_nBreakLevel, m_bCanBreak, m_nOtherEquipPos, itemEnforceRuleID, m_bIsLocal, instanceChannel/instanceChannelType.
Format strings: "%s + %d  " (name + enforce level), "%s %d  ", "%d*%d-" and "%d*%d" (jewel/socket column layout), "jewelEmpty" and "collumn" keys.
functions.notes: Very large decompile with many unreachable-block warnings; only the tooltip-field intent is confidently recovered. Not authoritative; enforce/break levels are read-only mirrors of server item state.

functions.purpose: Client marshaller: given an item-instance pointer (in_stack_00000010), resolves the item's static definition and pushes computed 'factual' item level, factual rank, rare type, and (if transmogrify/quench supported) transmogrify item id and quench level to AS3.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (reads server-replicated item state and shared static tables)
formulas: Type-tag test pattern used throughout chunk: (*(u32)(inst+off) & 0x8f)==<tag> selects a Lua/variant value slot; e.g. off+0x34 tag 2 -> byte at +0x38; off+0x64 tag 2 -> byte at +0x68; off+0x7c tag 5 -> u64 at +0x80.
Reads inst+0xac (flags; bit6 = has-owner-object at inst+0xa8), inst+0xb0/0xb4/0xb8.
Def resolution: cVar2!=0 -> FUN_107cb630(); else FUN_10858a70(); alt path FUN_10858670(u64,uVar1).
m_nFactItemLevel = def->vfunc(+0x18)(); m_nFactRank = FUN_11669840(); m_nRareType = def->vfunc(+0x2c)().
If FUN_116698a0()!=0 (transmog/quench enabled): m_nTransmogrifyItemId = def[0x7d]; m_nQuenchLevel = (short)def[0x7e].
functions.notes: The 0x8f mask + tag compares are the game's variant-cell decoding (tag in low nibble+0x80 bit), recurring in every AS3 handler in this chunk.

functions.purpose: Accessor: gets the CCraftInfo static-data manager (singleton pattern) then returns the craft-entry pointer at array index param_1 (bounds-checked against the entry vector).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (shared static table; server has same table)
formulas: Manager singleton via CCraftInfo::GetInfoManagerSingleton, else CInfoManager::FindByName("CCraftInfo"), else fallback &DAT_123bf070 (guard DAT_123bf0e0 bit0, init FUN_10806120).
Entry vector: begin=mgr[5], end=mgr[6]; count = (end-begin)>>2; if 0<=param_1<count return *(begin + param_1*4).
functions.notes: Craft-entry struct layout is defined by FUN_10894040 consumers (see that entry).

functions.purpose: Gets the CCraftInfo manager (same singleton pattern) and invokes its vtable method at +0x28 (returns craft-entry count / triggers list build). Used to size iteration in FUN_10894040.
formulas: Same manager resolution as FUN_10876b30; then call mgr->vfunc(+0x28)().
functions.notes: PTR_FUN_11dcaec4 / PTR_FUN_11da54a8 are the info-manager vtables.

formulas: Handler map: _getActivateTalentData->FUN_10878f20, _getTalentSkillData->FUN_10878f40, _activateWeaponTalentSkill->FUN_10878f60, _unactivateWeaponTalentSkill->FUN_10879000, _upgradeWeaponTalentSkill->FUN_108790b0.

functions.purpose: Data provider for the weapon-talent-skill panel. Reads the active-talent list and, per talent, pushes status/level info plus the full per-level upgrade cost table (level-up value, credit cost, level cap, and required material items with owned counts) to AS3. Also surfaces the player's current bound and unbound money for affordability checks.
functions.serverRelevance: validation-mirror / client-only (server computes and validates the actual talent upgrade; this recomputes costs client-side for the confirm dialog)
formulas: Talent entry (piVar8): [-1]=status, [0]=currentLevel, [1]=maxLevel, [2]=talentID, [3]=talentIndex, [7]=unlockLevel.
Per-level upgrade record (puVar9, iterated): [-3]=levelupValue, [-2]=levelupCost (currency), [-1]=levelLimit (level cap for this step).
Material sub-records per level step: [0]=itemID, [1]=itemCounts (required); currentItemCounts = FUN_113fa380(itemID) (player's owned amount of that item/credit).
roleBindMoney and roleMoney read from player context (piStack_8c chain via FUN_1025b060; talent list at context+0x260e0).
Active talent list built via CTalentActiveInfo::BuildActiveTalentList; level-up records enumerated via FUN_112b3940 / detailed via FUN_112b3e60.
costs: levelupCost = currency (money) charged per talent level-up step.
Per-step material requirements: itemID x itemCounts.
roleBindMoney (bound money) + roleMoney (unbound money) are the affordability pools.
functions.notes: FUN_113fa380(id) is the recurring 'get player's owned quantity of currency/item by id' helper (appears here, in FUN_1088eca0, and FUN_10894040).

functions.purpose: Builds the weapon-derive (weapon evolution/forge tree) node data for the UI. For each derive node emits weaponID, isForge, isAcquired, parentNodeID into a weaponArr, sourced from the CWeaponDerive static manager. Uses SKILL_VIDEO_WEAPON_DERIVE VO class names for the presentation objects.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (isAcquired reflects server-owned progress; tree topology is static data)
formulas: Manager via CWeaponDerive::GetManagers / CInfoManager::FindByName("CWeaponDerive").
Per node: weaponID, parentNodeID, boolean isForge (craftable), boolean isAcquired (player already owns/unlocked).
functions.notes: Cost/material data for a derive is fetched elsewhere; this fn only builds the tree topology + ownership flags.

functions.serverRelevance: client-only (the _request* handlers issue server RPCs; server validates cost and applies)
formulas: Handler map: _checkEquipUpgrade->FUN_1088d230, _requestEquipUpgrade->FUN_1088d770, _canEquipUpgrade->FUN_1088cbb0, _requestPutItemIn->FUN_1088dc50, _requestEquipUpgradeInfo->FUN_1088e010, _requrestAttributeData->FUN_1088e550, _openEquipShow->FUN_1088e940, _checkItemBindStateChange->FUN_1088ff50, _getLeveRange->FUN_10891b00.
Native helpers: GetNewEquipDeriveLevel->FUN_108912a0, CheckSlotChange->FUN_108913c0.
functions.notes: Cross-refs FUN_1088e010 (info provider) and FUN_1088eca0 (cost detail provider) in this chunk.

functions.purpose: Provider for _requestEquipUpgradeInfo (gated param_5==5). Reads player and source-equip state to populate the upgrade dialog header: isWeapon, roleLevel, srcEquipEnforceLv, awakeningLevel, roleHunterStarLv, hasWakeup, sourceRare, itemLevel, ItemRank, sourceItemName, bPointType, and the destination-equip candidate array (destEquipArray / destArrayLength).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (all values server-replicated; feeds the confirm UI)
formulas: Player context via DAT_1202e818->+0xd0->+0x90 vfunc(+0xb4); source-equip def via FUN_113f9bb0(equipId).
roleHunterStarLv via CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount; player field ctx[0xb47] gates the destination-array build.

Sentinels 0xdeadbeaf / -0x21524151 used when a variant cell is absent.
functions.notes: Header/context only; the money/material costs come from FUN_1088eca0.

functions.purpose: Provider that iterates the server-supplied equip-upgrade candidate entries (stride 0x88 bytes) and pushes the full cost/requirement breakdown per candidate to AS3: upgrade money, current money, craft-credit costs, enforce/break levels, requirements, and per-material availability (equipHasEnoughMaterial).
functions.serverRelevance: validation-mirror (server computes these cost fields; client re-surfaces them and computes affordability. Server must remain authoritative on upgradeMoney/nCraftMoney and material consumption).
formulas: Candidate entry base = param_3+4; iterated with stride 0x88 until reaching *(param_3_ctx+8). Entry field offsets:
+0x10 -> itemID (DAT_11dbb0b4 key); +0xc -> equipID; +0x24 -> equipRare; +0x28 -> itemLevel; +0x54 -> playerUseLevelMin; +0x58 -> playerUseLevelMax; +0x2c -> equipCounts.
+0x30 -> upgradeMoney (currency cost); +0x34 -> currentMoney (player-owned money snapshot); +0x6c(byte) -> needUnboundGold.
+0x04 -> enforceRequirement; +0x08 -> hunterstarRequirement; +0x38 -> rankDownLevel; +0x3c -> enforceDownLevel; +0x40 -> newRankLevel.
+0x4c(byte) -> bBindState; +0x18 -> enforceLevel; +0x1c -> breakLevel; +0x20(byte) -> canBreak; +0x50 -> enforceRuleID.
+0x60 -> nCraftCreditID; nOwnCraftCredit = FUN_113fa380(nCraftCreditID) (player-owned craft credit); +0x64 -> nCraftCreditMax; +0x68 -> nCraftMoney.
+0x7c -> material array; equipHasEnoughMaterial (byte at +0x14) set after checking arrayMaterialData counts via FUN_108910e0/FUN_1088f110.
Iteration gated on player ctx present and *(param_3+4) != *(local_4c+8).
costs: upgradeMoney = primary money cost of the equip upgrade/enforce step.
needUnboundGold = flag that cost must be paid in unbound gold.
nCraftMoney = secondary money cost; nCraftCreditID/nCraftCreditMax = craft-credit currency spent (capped at nCraftCreditMax); nOwnCraftCredit = player's owned amount.
Per-material requirement list at entry+0x7c with owned-vs-needed check driving equipHasEnoughMaterial.
functions.notes: Strong offset recovery from the sequential FUN_104d1550/104d15e0 marshalling calls (0x88-byte entry stride is confident). Server must validate upgradeMoney, nCraftMoney, craft-credit and material consumption; client is display + affordability only.

functions.purpose: Helper that formats/looks up the display name of an upgrade item and pushes it to AS3 as strUpgradeItemName.
formulas: Resolves item name string and calls FUN_104d1670("strUpgradeItemName", ...) (AS3 string setter).
functions.notes: Small string-formatting helper; no economic logic.

functions.purpose: Registers the forge UI AS3 handlers: InitModel, setPointMaterialData, requestForge.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (requestForge issues the server RPC; server validates cost and grants item)
formulas: Registers InitModel, setPointMaterialData, requestForge handlers via the AS3 register-native-function path.
functions.notes: requestForge is the client->server forge request; FUN_10894040 provides the forge list/costs shown before the request.

functions.purpose: Builds the forge/craft item list (gated mode param==2). Iterates all CCraftInfo entries, applies visibility filters (type, job/class-restriction arrays, map/distance-restriction arrays), and for each craftable entry pushes recipe metadata + costs + material requirements to a cached AS3 list (FORGE_ITEM_DATA_CLASS / forgeitemdataCacheList), supporting a strSearchKeyword filter.
functions.serverRelevance: validation-mirror (server owns the CCraftInfo table and validates cost/material consumption on the actual forge; client renders the same static data for the shop UI).
formulas: Iteration count = FUN_10876bc0(); per-index entry = FUN_10876b30(i). Visibility: FUN_108496a0()!=0 AND entry[0x11] (offset 0x44) != 2.
Job/class filter: entry[0x42]/[0x43] (0x108/0x10c) begin/end pointer pair; passes if empty or contains player's class token (compared vs puVar8 = player class).
Map/distance filter: entry[0x45]/[0x46] (0x114/0x118) begin/end pair; each id resolved via FUN_107d7930 then checked against current-map object vfunc(+0x2c); count=(end-begin)>>2.

Craft-entry field offsets (int index): [0x10]=canCraft base flag; vfunc(+0x18)=craftID; [0x12]=craftType; [0x13]=craftSubType; [0x17]=itemID (DAT_11dbb0b4 key); [0x15]=nLevelLimit; [0x20]=nMoney; [0x16]=nStarLimit; [0x14]=nDistanceType.
[0x21]=nCraftCreditID; nOwnCraftCredit = FUN_113fa380(nCraftCreditID); [0x22]=nCraftCreditMax; [0x23]=nCraftMoney.
Material list: entry[0x48]/[0x49] (0x120/0x124) begin/end pair, each record 2 ints: [0]=materialID (DAT_11dbb0b4 key), [1]=nNeedItemNum. Materials emitted into materialIDArr.
Item presentation: def = FUN_10254130(itemID); strItemIconName = def+0xb4; strItemDescrbie/strItemName from FUN_116bd4d0; empty (&DAT_11d9d32b) when def==0.
Final list committed via CCraftInfo::BuildCraftLists.
costs: nMoney = primary money cost to craft the recipe.
nCraftMoney = secondary money cost; nCraftCreditID/nCraftCreditMax = craft-credit currency spent (capped at nCraftCreditMax); nOwnCraftCredit = player-owned craft credit.
nLevelLimit = min player level; nStarLimit = min hunter-star; nDistanceType = required proximity/facility to craft.
functions.notes: Craft-entry offset map is well recovered from the ordered marshalling and matches the CCraftInfo layout hinted in schema/docs/economy.md (costA/costB = nMoney/nCraftMoney, credit component = nCraftCredit*). DAT_11dbb0b4 is the reused "itemID" AS3 key. Authoritative craft must be validated server-side against this same table.
